# Third-party material

| What | Where in the app | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inter (interface typeface) | `app/src/main/res/font/inter.ttf` | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter), Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`inter-OFL.txt`) |
| EB Garamond (display serif: name, counts, quotations) | `app/src/main/res/font/eb_garamond_*.ttf` | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ebgaramond), Copyright 2017 The EB Garamond Project Authors | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`eb-garamond-OFL.txt`) |
| Noto Emoji (monochrome emoji font) | `app/src/main/res/font/noto_emoji.ttf` | [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notoemoji), Copyright 2013, 2022 Google | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`noto-emoji-OFL.txt`) |
| Nicomachean Ethics, tr. H. Rackham (1926) | quotations in `data/Quotes.kt` | [Perseus Digital Library](https://github.com/PerseusDL/canonical-greekLit) | Text CC BY-SA 4.0 (Perseus edition) |

The OFL allows each font to be bundled with software, including commercial software, as long as
the font itself isn't sold on its own and its licence travels with it. Copies ship inside the app
under `assets/licenses/` and are shown in Settings → About.
